title: app-host app.json
description: How the app host runs one application. String values may use ${NAME}, ${NAME:-default} and ${NAME:?message}, resolved from the .env next to this file.

name.description: Prefixes the container and image names (<name>-api, <name>-web).

displayName.description: Heads the application's group on the Resources page. Defaults to name.

type.description: atom-webapp: an ASP.NET Core API and an nginx container serving the SPA.

registry.description: Defaults to the app host's AppHost:Registry (ghcr.io/hwndmaster).

port.description: A port number, or a ${NAME} string that expands to one.

hostPort.description: Published on the server, at the app host's AppHost:BindAddress.

memory.description: Memory limit in docker's notation: 384m, 1g. Unset leaves the container unlimited.

host.description: A path on the server. On Docker Desktop for Windows a forward-slash Windows path: C:/Docker/MyApp/Data.

environment.description: Variables set in the container. One whose value expands to an empty string is left out.

ports.description: Further published ports, e.g. a web container's HTTPS listener.
